_note: The hand-written half of /feedback (the counts are in feedbackStats.json, from the kitchen PC). `asked`: what customers asked for, grouped into themes and counted from the survey's 'add to the menu' and 'bring you in more often' answers, e.g. { "label": "More soups", "count": 9 }, with an optional `reply` shown under it when the answer is no for now (client 2026-10-28: no fryer, and the managers and cooks all work days). `changes`: 'You said, we did', from the 'do better' answers: { "said": "Long wait at noon", "did": "What changed, or 'Working on it'", "date": "2026-11-02" }. Never a customer's words here (those only go in as permitted quotes) and never a staff name. Empty lists simply don't show.
